result.topic_en: A list of research notes: treating certain functions by analogy with Eisenstein's work on the p-function via infinite products, addition theorems for p and σ, turning covariant criteria into invariant ones, decomposition conditions for binary forms in several variables, vanishing of transvectants, Klein's topic of a typical representation of the Kummer surface, and termination of chains of transvection processes.
